Stadium Capital Management Llc bought 1.19M shares as the company’s stock rose 18.32% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Alexander Medina Seaver held 3.00 million shares of the health care company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $46.23 million, up from 1.81 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stadium Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Civitas Solutions Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $614.28M market cap company. The stock decreased 1.18% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $16.75. About 33,935 shares traded. Civitas Solutions, Inc. (NYSE:CIVI) has declined 3.43% since June 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 16.00% the S&P500.
